image.subject: a young woman in her twenties, thin, hair tied back, ragged colonial dress and shawl, mud on her hands, a baby strapped to her back, standing alone at the edge of a freshly filled shallow grave in a wet freezing meadow at dusk, head bowed

storyboard.claim: We invest in a life and the story buries it and moves on.
storyboard.concreteVisual: a grieving woman beside a fresh mound of earth in a cold meadow
storyboard.relationToPrevious: turns from the abstract complaint to the felt weight of loss
storyboard.addedInformation: the burial as the image of empathy left unresolved

storyboard.claim: The discomfort is the point of the whole experience.
storyboard.concreteVisual: a text card carrying the claim in large type

image.subject: a rugged English militiaman in his thirties, beard, leather jerkin and wide-brimmed hat, musket at his side, standing proudly on a rocky rise above a vast dark forest, chin lifted, as if the whole land were his stage, late afternoon light

storyboard.claim: Humans think they are the main characters of the universe.
storyboard.concreteVisual: a proud man posed high above a huge forest
storyboard.relationToPrevious: moves from the point to the human vanity it targets
storyboard.addedInformation: human self-importance shown against a vast woodland

image.subject: an older woman in her sixties, weathered face, grey hair under a plain cap, a worn wool cloak and apron, looking at her own reflection in a still dark pond in a forest clearing, her face small and dim beside tall trees mirrored in the water

storyboard.claim: Our loves and wars feel central, but the story forces us to see the humbling truth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: a woman looking at her reflection in forest water, dwarfed by mirrored trees
storyboard.relationToPrevious: turns the vanity into a look in the mirror
storyboard.addedInformation: mirror image made literal as a pond reflection

left.label: TRAGIC HEROES
left.subject: a young woman in her twenties, thin, hair tied back, ragged colonial dress and shawl, mud on her hands, a baby strapped to her back, standing tall and noble in a forest clearing, soft light

right.label: APOCALYPTIC VILLAINS
right.subject: a rugged English militiaman in his thirties, beard, leather jerkin and wide-brimmed hat, musket at his side, standing in dark smoke at the edge of a burned forest

storyboard.claim: Humans are neither grand tragic heroes nor grand villains of the earth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: two figures side by side, the noble sufferer and the menacing soldier, each labeled and rejected
storyboard.relationToPrevious: names the two roles humans are denied
storyboard.addedInformation: both flattering and damning roles are removed

storyboard.claim: To the forest we are seasonal crops that sprout, make noise and are harvested by time.
storyboard.concreteVisual: a harvested field with a scythe at the edge of the woods
storyboard.relationToPrevious: gives the forest's view of humans a concrete metaphor
storyboard.addedInformation: harvest as the picture of human life cycles

image.subject: a mossy fallen oak log rotting on the floor of a forest in colonial Massachusetts, fern shoots and small white mushrooms and a young sapling pushing up through the dark crumbling wood, soft misty morning light

storyboard.claim: We rot down to feed the soil for whatever wild thing grows next.
storyboard.concreteVisual: a decaying log with a sapling growing out of it
storyboard.relationToPrevious: follows the harvest with decay and renewal
storyboard.addedInformation: new growth fed by what falls

image.subject: a quiet peaceful patch of New England woods in early morning, the leaf-covered forest floor showing slight unnatural low bumps and mounds in the earth between tree roots, a walker's boots visible at the edge of the frame looking down

storyboard.claim: Look down at the slight unnatural bumps in the earth when you walk in quiet woods.
storyboard.concreteVisual: low mounds in the leaf litter seen from a walker's eye height
storyboard.relationToPrevious: turns the argument into an instruction for the viewer
storyboard.addedInformation: the clue to look for: bumps in the ground

image.subject: a massive old pine tree in a dark forest clearing with one huge branch bent at a strange sharp elbow angle, thick bark in close view, shafts of pale light through the needles

storyboard.claim: Notice the weird sharp angle of a massive pine branch.
storyboard.concreteVisual: a pine branch with an abrupt elbow bend
storyboard.relationToPrevious: moves from the ground to the trees
storyboard.addedInformation: the second clue: a branch that grew around something

storyboard.claim: Ask what violent, beautiful drama lies behind what you see.
storyboard.concreteVisual: a text card posing the question in large type
storyboard.relationToPrevious: turns the observed clues into a question
storyboard.addedInformation: invitation to imagine the history under the woods

image.subject: a lone traveler seen from behind in plain wool clothes standing still on a quiet leaf-covered forest floor among tall pines at dawn, mist at his boots, the ground around him dark and rich, as if listening to what lies beneath

storyboard.claim: A forgotten human drama is fertilizing the ground you stand on right now.
storyboard.concreteVisual: a person standing still on rich forest earth at dawn
storyboard.relationToPrevious: lands the question on the viewer standing in the woods
storyboard.addedInformation: the closing image: the viewer on the ground of the story
